title: Naming a wish while leaving choice
meaning: You can thoughtfully name a strong wish behind a request and feel close while keeping a desired agreement distinct from a required answer.
text: The Hermit in the physical position of your Vishuddha helps you explain what you have understood about your own request. The Devil in energy directs attention towards honestly examining a binding condition: whether the words conceal an expectation of only one acceptable response. The Lovers in emotions bring closeness when agreement feels freely given. Together, these roles allow you to express a strong wish directly without presenting it as a commitment already accepted by each other.

For example, you suggest listening to a favourite album together and recognise, after reflection, that you want company and shared enthusiasm. **A desired response has not been promised in advance**. You can explain why the music matters and hear genuine agreement to listen without knowing the eventual impression. Closeness appears in being beside each other’s interest even if the answer about the music differs. The request becomes clearer when its unspoken condition no longer needs to be guessed.

Yet a considered admission can quietly become an argument: because the wish matters so much, it ought to be fulfilled. Warm participation then starts depending on the required judgement. The Devil’s constructive honesty helps you notice and name this binding connection without accusation. Willingness remains when you can express the response you hope for without making it the price of closeness itself.
